The medium engine is a [diesel engine](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Propulsion/DieselEngines) which offers the highest power-to-weight ratio of any of the built-in diesel engines. used on planes for his design (power at the other side then other imputs and outputs)
